title: Contextual snippet playbook for rollout + cost education
creator: Marisol Vega
description:
Goal: Design and validate a small, reusable set of contextual UI "snippets" (tooltip + microcard + quick-start template) that surface guided education for the Console's rollout and cost dashboards. These snippets should be lightweight, dismissible, and composable so product teams can assemble flows for first-time users and staged discovery for returning users.

Scope: (1) empty-state microcard for Rollouts page that explains canary/A-B flows and links to a quick-start template; (2) cost-breakdown tooltip cluster that explains token vs infra costs and shows an interactive cost-saver suggestion; (3) a one-click template import modal that seeds a rollout or cost-checklist in a project. Include low-fi and clickable Figma prototype; run two short guerilla usability sessions (5-7 participants) and iterate on copy and timing.

Acceptance criteria:
- Components available as 3 composable snippets in the design system (microcard, tooltip cluster, import modal).
- Prototype demonstrates onboarding path for new Console users and a progressive discovery path for returning users.
- Usability score: tasks (understand rollout concept, import template) completed by 80% of participants without facilitator hints.
- Performance constraints: UI must not add more than one extra network request on page load (suggest lazy-load the snippet assets).
- Accessibility: keyboard focusable, ARIA labels for all controls, contrast >= WCAG AA.

Out of scope: full onboarding checklist feature, backend provisioning of templates (engineering will implement ingestion API separately).
comments: 2025-03-06 - Kickoff: PM and Eng aligned on scope. Decision: start with Rollouts and Cost Overview, then expand to Dashboard-level prompts later.

2025-03-07 - Exploration: sketched three approaches: modal-first, inline microcard, and side-rail persistent coach. Team prefers inline microcard + ephemeral tooltip cluster to avoid interrupting flows.

2025-03-09 - Prototype review: Figma v1 clickable created. Feedback from Riley (PM): need explicit CTA copy for 'Import template' that clarifies what it will change. Feedback from Sienna (Eng): request to minimize extra API calls; agreed to lazy-load template metadata.
2025-03-11 - Usability plan: 6 participants booked (3 new Console users, 3 existing users). Recruit notes: include engineers who have never created a rollout. Script attached in Confluence.
2025-03-12 - Design update: tightened copy, added 'Why this matters' microline to cost tooltip to reduce cognitive load. Preparing handoff assets for Eng spike (ENG-61802).
